dropped.claim: The 2025 results represent severe margin stress—operating income swung from $117.0M to -$10.0M and gross profit per WSEE fell 15%—but three critical uncertainties prevent concluding this is permanent impairment versus a cyclical pricing reset: (1) the company maintained $642.0M cash and continued dividends/buybacks despite the loss, indicating balance sheet resilience; (2) management demonstrated cost discipline by cutting operating expenses per WSEE from $253 to $245; and (3) the partially self-funded insurance accounting creates estimation volatility that may have amplified the apparent 9% benefits cost increase. The structural challenge is real—annual pricing cycles lag healthcare cost inflation—but prior profitability through 2024 and new product flexibility (Scale solution) leave the outcome uncertain. The next 6-12 months of pricing actions, claims development, and Scale adoption will determine whether this is recovery or deterioration.
